Anita (CSM): heads up — Orion Labs dedicated bring-up. Cutover target Wed 2026-04-07. Need final quota headroom numbers + autoscale policy. Who owns load generation?
Maya (Onboard): I'll own load gen. Can someone confirm expected qps/avg token size and peak burst factor?
Alex (Orion): Our baseline steady qps ~ 120, avg tokens 40, peak bursts up to 900 for short spikes (~30s). Renewal note: if go-live slips >2w we need contract extension conversation.
Luca (Solutions): Recommend ramp -> soak -> burst. Plan: 0→30% (10m) → 60% (20m) → 100% (10m) then 1h soak at 100% then 3x 30s bursts at 3x peak. Here's a k6 snippet for reference:
```js
export default function() {
  http.post('https://redwood-test.example/api/generate', payload, params);
}
```
Maya (Onboard): thanks. I'll parameterize by qps and tokens. Where do we push results?
Sam (SRE): Upload to /ml/onboard/orion/loadtests S3. Autoscale policy suggestions:
- min_nodes: 2
- target_util: 0.65
- scale_up_cooldown: 45s
- scale_down_cooldown: 5m
Also add a circuit-breaker at 85% to fail open to fallback model.
Derek (Onboard Eng): For KV priming, run:
`python prime_kv.py --customer orion --rate 200 --duration 1800`
Do this 2h before soak. It'll reduce cold-starts by ~30%.
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-04-05T01:22Z started for dedicated-pool/orion (build: 7f3a2d)
Maya (Onboard): timeline proposal:
- 2026-04-05: deploy validation + smoke (10m)
- 2026-04-06: full soak (1h) + soak analysis
- 2026-04-07: go-live, traffic ramp with ops oncall
Anita (CSM): risk & escalation: if we can't guarantee burst headroom 3x, mark renewal risk = medium -> notify sales by EOD.
Luca (Solutions): Also recommend enabling request-level fallbacks to smaller model for non-critical routes.
Alex (Orion): confirm we can do priming 2h before soak. Thanks, team.
Sam (SRE): I'll run a dry-run autoscale test during smoke window and post metrics.
Maya (Onboard): i'll share k6 param file + run command after lunch. Thanks :thumbsup:
Anita (CSM): perfect — no blockers noted. I'll schedule a 30m pre-soak huddle on 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Ping here with any changes.
